why-it-was-blocked.primary: The action declared a producer invocation of scripts/ci/compiled-root.rkt that could not execute as written: the CLI required --checkout/--module/--final-dir while the action passed a whole-checkout form, so no trusted root was ever published. The text-only contract test matched the declared string and the rollback drill drove the CLI with the correct flags, so both '109/109 focused' and '1202/1202 fast' went green on a broken call.
